title: foeniculum graecum
intro: Foeniculum graecum, commonly known as Sweet Fennel, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. It has been widely used for its culinary and medicinal properties, offering numerous health benefits such as aiding digestion, reducing flatulence, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Foeniculum graecum are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include anethole, fenchone, limonene, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
